78:3: That they are in disagreement over it
78:5: Then no, surely they will know.
78:6: Did We not make the earth a bed?
78:7: And We made the mountains pegs.
78:9: We made your sleep a rest.
78:10: We made the night a covering.
78:11: We made the day a time of livelihood.
78:12: Above you We built seven strong ones.
78:13: And We made a lamp burning brightly.
78:14: And from the condensed clouds We sent down water pouring abundantly.
78:15: So that We may bring forth with it the grain and the vegetation
78:17: Indeed, the Day of Separation was an appointed time.
78:18: On that day the Sur is blown, and you come in groups.
78:19: And the sky was opened, so it became gates.
78:20: And the mountains are moved, so they become a mirage.
78:21: Indeed, Hell has become an observation place.
78:24: They do not taste therein any coolness nor any drink.
78:26: As an appropriate recompense and punishment.
78:27: Because they were not expecting a reckoning.
78:28: And they denied Our signs with a denial.
78:29: We have counted everything with a book.
78:30: So taste, We will not increase you in anything except punishment.
78:31: Indeed, for the owners of taqwa there is a salvation.
78:35: They do not hear therein vain talk and falsehood.
78:36: As a recompense from your Rabb, a sufficient gift.
78:37: The Rabb of the heavens, the earth, and what is between the two is al-Rahman. They have no power to address Him.
78:38: The day the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, no one speaks except the one whom al-Rahman has permitted and who spoke what is right.
78:39: That day is the truth; so whoever wills takes a place of return to his Rabb.
78:40: We have warned you of a near punishment. On that day a person looks at what his hands have put forth, and the disbeliever says: Wish that I were dust.
